# EasyReview

> EasyReview helps local businesses turn happy customers into 5-star Google reviews with QR codes, while routing unhappy feedback privately before it reaches Google.

EasyReview is a review-growth product for local businesses in India and beyond. Customers scan a counter QR, rate their visit, get AI-drafted review text for 4–5★ experiences, or submit private feedback for 1–3★.

## Pages

- [Home](https://easyreview.co.in/): Product overview, how it works, and features
- [Pricing](https://easyreview.co.in/pricing): Plans, early-bird offer, and add-ons
- [Competitor analysis](https://easyreview.co.in/competitor-analysis): Compare your Google presence against nearby competitors
- [Guides](https://easyreview.co.in/guides): Practical Google review playbooks for local businesses
- [Restaurant QR reviews guide](https://easyreview.co.in/guides/restaurant-qr-code-google-reviews): How restaurants use QR codes to get more 5-star Google reviews
- [FAQ](https://easyreview.co.in/faq): Common questions about EasyReview
